phrase: develop prescriptions for AI-fueled inequality
meaning: 应对方案；prescription 原义「处方」，此处引申为政策主张
sentence: America's billionaires are developing their own prescriptions for AI-fueled inequality.

phrase: defuse a populist revolt
meaning: 化解、平息（原义拆弹 → 化解冲突）
sentence: They are anxious to defuse a populist revolt aimed at their ballooning fortunes.

phrase: ballooning fortunes
meaning: 急剧膨胀的（财富像气球一样胀大）
sentence: A populist revolt aimed at their ballooning fortunes.

phrase: dramatically raised the stakes of the wealth-tax debate
meaning: 提高赌注/利害关系，使局面更严峻
sentence: The AI boom has dramatically raised the stakes of the wealth-tax debate.

phrase: wipe out millions of jobs
meaning: 消灭、摧毁；此处指大规模失业
sentence: A technology that could wipe out millions of jobs while minting the world's first trillionaires.

phrase: minting the world's first trillionaires
meaning: 制造、催生（原义铸币 → 创造新富豪）
sentence: AI could wipe out millions of jobs while minting the world's first trillionaires.

phrase: the world's first trillionaire
meaning: 万亿富翁（比 billionaire 更高一级）
sentence: SpaceX IPO could help make him the world's first trillionaire.

phrase: capitalism's next great reckoning
meaning: 清算、算总账的时刻
sentence: Populist politicians have cast this as capitalism's next great reckoning.

phrase: cast this as capitalism's next great reckoning
meaning: 把此事描绘成/定性为
sentence: Populist politicians, particularly on the left, have cast this as capitalism's next great reckoning.

phrase: an economy already rigged for the elite
meaning: 被操纵的、对某方有利的
sentence: An even deeper concentration of wealth and power in an economy already rigged for the elite.

phrase: destabilize the economy
meaning: 使（经济）不稳定
sentence: Some of the richest men in tech have warned for years AI could destabilize the economy.

phrase: not deceleration or wealth taxes, but shared abundance
meaning: 共享的富足、普惠繁荣
sentence: Many suggest the answer is not deceleration or wealth taxes, but shared abundance.

phrase: not deceleration or wealth taxes, but shared abundance
meaning: 句式：不是 A 或 B，而是 C
sentence: The answer is not deceleration or wealth taxes, but shared abundance.

phrase: a longtime proponent of universal basic income
meaning: 全民基本收入（UBI），定期发钱
sentence: Sam Altman, a longtime proponent of universal basic income, now favors universal basic compute.

phrase: favors universal basic compute
meaning: Altman 造词：全民基本算力，每人获得 AI 使用配额
sentence: Altman now favors universal basic compute — giving people access to AI's productive power instead of a fixed cash payment.

phrase: called for universal HIGH INCOME checks
meaning: 呼吁、主张
sentence: Elon Musk has called for universal HIGH INCOME checks from the federal government.

phrase: Between the lines
meaning: Axios 小标题：解读言外之意
sentence: Between the lines: The billionaires floating these ideas are keenly aware that the politics of extreme wealth could turn dangerous fast.

phrase: keenly aware that the politics of extreme wealth could turn dangerous fast
meaning: 非常清楚、高度警觉
sentence: The billionaires and AI leaders floating these ideas are keenly aware that the politics of extreme wealth could turn dangerous fast.

phrase: a pragmatic argument for billionaires to support higher taxes
meaning: 务实的、讲现实的

word: a good version / a bad version
phrase: If they don't support a good version, they'll inevitably get a bad version designed by a mob
meaning: 好方案 vs 坏方案；不参与设计 → 被动接受更糟结果
sentence: If they don't support a good version, they'll inevitably get a bad version designed by a mob.

phrase: April policy blueprint
meaning: 政策蓝图、框架

phrase: an organizing principle for the Democratic Party
meaning: 组织原则、核心纲领

phrase: overhauling the tax code
meaning: 全面改革（税法）

phrase: the enemy is the oligarchy
meaning: 寡头政治、寡头阶层

phrase: a one-time 5% billionaire wealth tax
meaning: 财富税，对巨额净资产征税
sentence: Unions gathered signatures to put a one-time 5% billionaire wealth tax on the November ballot.

phrase: casting himself as the billionaire who wants to tax other billionaires
meaning: 把自己塑造成…

phrase: The pitchforks are here, they're not just coming

phrase: whether AI creates shared prosperity
meaning: 共享繁荣

phrase: wealth concentration that could break society
meaning: 撕裂/摧毁社会

phrase: wipe out millions of jobs while minting trillionaires
meaning: 句式：while 连接两个对比结果（失业 vs 造富）

phrase: anxious to defuse a populist revolt
meaning: 句式：形容词短语作状语，省略主语 they，表示「急于…」

phrase: Why it matters
meaning: Axios 体例小标题：说明「为何重要」

phrase: The bottom line
meaning: Axios 体例小标题：总结核心判断

phrase: curb classroom screen use
meaning: 限制、遏制（curb 原义「路缘石」，引申为把某事物压下去）

phrase: amid concerns about student attention
meaning: 在……之中；伴随着（多指复杂背景下的情况）
